resources.string: That doesn\'t look like a web address. Try something like example.com

Type the address of the page you want to keep running, then press Go.

It keeps running with the screen off, and when you leave the app, until you tap Stop in its notification. Every tab keeps running.

If nothing on a page changes for 5 minutes while the connection is fine, the phone buzzes once to say it seems to have stopped.
Open in new tab, stay here
No connection, trying again every 10 seconds
Shows while pages are kept running, with a Stop button.

Under Battery, choose Unrestricted, so the phone never puts the app to sleep.
Open the phone\'s Settings, then Apps, then Keep Page Loading, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted.
